segments.normalizedSource: ```swift N = 1 << Log2N; scale = 0 < Direction ? 1 : 1./N; // Repeat M times: for (m = 0; m < M; ++m) { // Define a complex vector, h: for (j = 0; j < N; ++j) h[j] = A->realp[m*IMA + j*IA] + i * A->imagp[m*IMA + j*IA]; // Perform Discrete Fourier Transform. for (k = 0; k < N; ++k) H[k] = scale * sum(h[j] * e**(-Direction*2*pi*i*j*k/N), 0 <= j < N); // Store result. for (k = 0; k < N; ++k) { C->realp[m*IM + k*IC] = Re(H[k]); C->imagp[m*IM + k*IC] = Im(H[k]); } } ```
